name: Qdrant Multitenant RAG Tiering
purpose: A multi-tenant RAG service that serves hot tenants from Qdrant, parks idle tenants' collections as verified snapshots in Backblaze B2, restores them on the next query, and measures what that costs in latency and saves in memory.
tagline: Keep vector memory for the tenants who query; park the rest in B2.

features.title: Tenants
features.summary: create tenants from text or Markdown files (or seed demo tenants), one Qdrant collection each, corpus in B2

features.title: Tiering
features.summary: idle policy and manual park: snapshot, multipart upload to B2, manifest last, verify, then drop

features.title: Restore on query
features.summary: the first query to a parked tenant restores it from B2 into any Qdrant node and reports the cost

features.title: Latency report
features.summary: benchmark warm, restore and post-restore latency plus memory freed, stored as report.json in B2

features.title: Library
features.summary: the app's own objects under rag/, grouped by tenant and kind

features.title: Bucket explorer
features.summary: full-bucket browse, preview, download and delete, streamed through the API

features.title: Dashboard
features.summary: hot, parked and empty counts, vector memory in use and freed, bytes in B2, recent reports

features.title: Settings
features.summary: read-only tiering policy and the browser theme

b2_surface.why: tenant documents, _tenant.json, latest.json (written last) and report.json
stream a Qdrant snapshot to B2 without holding it in memory; abort on any failure so no partial object appears
verify snapshot size against the manifest, the /health probe (head_bucket) and file metadata
re-read a snapshot to verify its sha256, download it for restore, read corpus, manifests and reports, and proxy preview and download
bucket explorer, Library view, tenant discovery, snapshot history and report list
bucket explorer delete, tenant delete scoped to its corpus and snapshot prefixes, opt-in snapshot prune, end-to-end test cleanup

stack.web: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Recharts
stack.api: FastAPI, Python 3.12, boto3, qdrant-client, fastembed, Pydantic v2
stack.storage: Backblaze B2 (S3-compatible API) with Qdrant v1.20.2 as the hot tier

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID
env_vars.note: B2 application key ID (**keyID** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY
env_vars.note: B2 application key (**applicationKey**) — shown once at creation

env_vars.name: B2_BUCKET_NAME
env_vars.note: bucket unique name (**Bucket Unique Name** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_REGION
env_vars.note: the region inside the bucket's **Endpoint** (`s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com`); the S3 endpoint is derived from it

env_vars.name: B2_PUBLIC_URL_BASE
env_vars.note: public object base URL, when the bucket is public

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
env_vars.note: API origin the browser calls; Next.js inlines it at build time (Compose passes http://localhost:8000)

env_vars.name: QDRANT_URL
env_vars.note: Qdrant node for hot tenants; default http://localhost:6333, Compose sets http://qdrant:6333

env_vars.name: RAG_PREFIX
env_vars.note: key prefix for everything the app writes; default rag/

env_vars.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
env_vars.note: any fastembed text model; default BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5

env_vars.name: TIERING_IDLE_SECONDS
env_vars.note: idle time before a hot tenant is a parking candidate; default 604800 (7 days)

env_vars.name: TIERING_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS
env_vars.note: background sweep cadence; default 300, 0 disables it

env_vars.name: SNAPSHOT_PART_SIZE_BYTES
env_vars.note: multipart part size for snapshot uploads; default 8388608, minimum 5 MiB

env_vars.name: SNAPSHOT_PRUNE_ENABLED
env_vars.note: allow /snapshots/prune to delete superseded snapshots; default false
